race.description: Peter Milling And Company Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: TAMPA BAY (11) is finding it tough to break through but has efforts littered throughout her form that measure up, including two narrow defeats already this campaign. Doesn't need to improve much off those to be winning this. COSMIC JINKS (14) returned from a spell two weeks ago when she was in contention on the corner before being fading quickly in the run home at Scone. Strips fitter and can play a more significant role with that run under her belt. SHE'S OURVALENTINE (9) was prominent through the early and middle stages but peaked on her run and finished fourth when resuming over 1000m at Dubbo last start. Right in the mix. TUCKLAN (13) produced a moderate effort last start at Dubbo but hadn't been too far prior. Peak fitness now and warrants safekeeping.
